## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The criterion hint should be corrected because following it produces rejected input when the supported `require_shall=True` option is enabled.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/criteria.py:1 — correctness — With `require_shall=True`, a criterion following the new hint, such as `- Save the result`, is rejected. The hint says “without the word shall,” while the validator requires `" shall "` in that mode; `test_plain_bullet_under_shall_option` confirms this behavior. Qualify the hint to explain when “shall” is required, or select its wording according to the option. — Users following the writing guidance cannot produce an accepted criterion in the required-“shall” mode.

## Suggestions
(none)

## Strengths
- The revised bullet hint shows the exact `- ` prefix required by the validator.
- Existing tests cover acceptance and rejection with both validator options.
